Speakers wired backwards are the most common error in sound system setup, cause big problems, and are easily corrected. Speaker Pop works by watching for a proprietary "pop" sound from the speaker, and doing DSP analysis of the sound to determine if the speaker cone is moving in the correct direction.

As long as you use a standard 1/8" stereo plug, you can use any normal 1/8" to RCA adapter to get the signal into your system. You can also to record the "pop" test signal to a CD, DVD, or another iPod, and play this signal through your speakers.

In a few seconds you will get the reading on the screen, either a Plus or a Minus. Plus indicates correct speaker polarity, Minus means you need to swap the wires coming into the speaker.

The app is used for EAR and VOCAL exercises. It's a very professional music training app. You can do ear training and sight-singing practices.

* The practices include pitch, interval, chord(includes inversions), scale, rhythm, melodic, etc.
* The app record your practices, so you can know your scores anytime.
* The app can remind you to do practices based on the learning schedule.
* It's very easy to use for anyone. You can use it in anywhere and anytime.

The Education version will add more class features for university or school. If you choose Volume Purchase Plan, this version is preferred because it has no in-app purchases.

Envelope is a high class reverb audio unit for use as a standalone app, using Inter App Audio or as an Audio Unit in AUv3 hosts like Garageband, Cubasis or AuriaPro. Its true stereo reverberation algorithm creates ultra-realistic acoustic spaces. Eight basic room models are contained in this unit, all of which can be tweaked in size, predelay, depth, low- and high frequency content as well as stereo width. A dry-wet-control is also included, plus a carefully designed set of presets to get you started. 
Envelope has already found its way into many recording studios around the world as a desktop plugin, and is now the first effect by the renowned plugin manufactory DDMF to be released for the iOS platform.
